problem.title: Group Anagrams
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; original Chinese explanation and proof.
facts: Group strings that are anagrams of one another.
The result may be returned in any order.
The character domain is lowercase English letters.

claims.claim: The 26-frequency tuple is a canonical key: equal keys iff strings are anagrams.
claims.validation: Per-character count construction and key-equivalence proof.

claims.claim: Time O(L + 26k), where L is total input characters and k is number of strings.
claims.validation: Each character is counted once and each tuple contains 26 entries.
